findings.title: Windows update has no timeout under INSTALL_LOCK
findings.problem: On Windows, npm_install_cli and the `node <cli> --version` validation use blocking .output() with no timeout, inside apply_update while INSTALL_LOCK is held. The mac module bounds these with NPM_TIMEOUT and CLI_CHECK_TIMEOUT.
findings.impact: A hung npm or broken CLI (prompt, antivirus scan, network stall) blocks the update thread forever; ensure_runtime takes the same INSTALL_LOCK, so app launch/runtime install stalls.
findings.recommendation: Spawn the children and kill them after a timeout (e.g. 600s for npm, 60s for validation), treating timeout as failure so the live CLI stays and the lock is released.

fix.change: Windows npm install (600s) and node --version validation (60s) run via output_timeout, which kills the child and errors on timeout
